sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Removes the ads from Flipp's home feed, search results, and flyers.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Signs in with Google through GmsCore instead of Google Play services.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Skips the spotlights and tutorials that walk a new user through the app.
Opens store links at the store's own page, without affiliate tags or click tracking.
